adventure.subtitle: Sealed royal spire and Royal Path nexus

authorityRules.worldPrecedence: Arentor Master Canon > current structured Arentoria data > this current-adventure reference > legacy material.
authorityRules.sessionRule: This file describes prepared/local truth. It does not prove that the party discovered, took, killed, activated or learned anything; current-session transcript/evidence must prove table events.
authorityRules.optionalRule: Explicit options, optional treasure, suggested complications and unresolved alternatives are not canon until selected or established.

localEntities.shortDescription: Private royal retreat with a laid dining table, silverwood writing desk, personal shrine, spyglass, signal horn and a black-mirror Royal Path portal.
Deep-blue carpet woven with an eight-pointed silver star; an oath-marked character stepping onto it causes blue light to race through the spire and visibly strengthens the surrounding nimbus.
localEntities.sourceSection: Entry Room and Study — Star-Loom Carpet

localEntities.shortDescription: Pale metallic silverwood desk whose sunburst-marked drawer opens for someone sworn to Seralith or Aerlan, or can be picked.
localEntities.sourceSection: Entry Room and Study — Silverwood Writing Desk

localEntities.shortDescription: Dark horn banded with gold that can sound a tower-wide note and interact with ancient tower defenses.
localEntities.sourceSection: Entry Room and Study — The Signal Horn

localEntities.shortDescription: High royal courier chamber and balcony equipped with a ballista, signal brazier, message gear and flying saddles; it is the prepared location of the local orc siege breach.
Large tapestry depicting Seralith and Aerlan flying side by side on griffons with royal courier formations.
localEntities.sourceSection: Sky Courier Balcony — Tapestry of the Skyguard

localEntities.shortDescription: Two exceptionally well-made nonmagical flying saddles designed for griffons or similar mounts, emphasizing rider safety and message transport.
localEntities.sourceSection: Sky Courier Balcony — The Flying Saddles

localEntities.shortDescription: Compact swivel-mounted ballista on the balcony with a rack of bolts inside the chamber.
Preserved private bedchamber shared by Seralith and Aerlan, containing personal clothing, portraits, cosmetics and a concealed strongbox.

localEntities.canonicalName: Moonlight in the Warrens: A Private Portfolio
localEntities.shortDescription: Numbered collection of risqué rabbit-folk woodcut prints hidden in a three-lock strongbox beneath the royal bed.
Preserved cosmetics and tools that automatically apply an archaic Seralith/Aerlan-era court style when someone sits at the makeup table.
Private portrait showing Seralith informally beside a window with a songbird and traces of ordinary domestic life.
localEntities.sourceSection: Royal Bedchamber — Portrait of Queen Seralith

localEntities.shortDescription: Private portrait showing Aerlan in court dress with a younger Varney holding one of the king’s gloves.
localEntities.sourceSection: Royal Bedchamber — Portrait of King Aerlan

localEntities.shortDescription: Immaculate preserved royal kitchen with three kitchen attendants, silverwood work surfaces, emergency-use equipment and stairs leading upward.
Three non-sentient constructs built for cooking, private-chamber maintenance and emergency response; they activate under the kitchen emergency protocol.
Sunlit upper sanctuary centered on a living tree whose roots embrace a black-mirror Royal Path portal.
Ancient transplanted living tree that anchors the Nexus portal and bears royal-symbol imagery; its exact degree of sentience is unresolved.
localEntities.sourceSection: Nexus Chamber — The Tree / Tree’s Nature
localEntities.notes: Do not choose among Silent Guardian / Semi-Sentient / Awakened Guardian options unless later canon or session evidence resolves it.

localEntities.shortDescription: Healing fruit hidden in a knot among the Nexus roots.
localEntities.notes: Likely related to the Master Canon Silverwood fruit, but this local source does not itself use the name Silverwood; do not silently merge based on this file alone.

localEntities.shortDescription: Dusty forbidden storeroom reached from the King’s Spire portal beneath the modern House of Crowns; old carpets cover the toppled receiving portal and chests, wine barrels and suits of armor line the room.
Large black guardian dog at King’s Spire who bonds readily with a friendly character and appears in an old private portrait with Aerlan.
localEntities.sourceSection: Entry Room and Study / Royal Bedchamber

localEntities.shortDescription: Named final testament of Queen Seralith preserved on the silverwood writing desk.
localEntities.sourceSection: Entry Room and Study — Seralith’s Testament

durableLocalFacts: A private meal for two is preserved in place, with evidence that both diners had begun eating.
The room contains a personal shrine to Seralith, a spyglass aimed toward the approaches below, and a black-mirror Royal Path endpoint.
The surrounding blue ward/nimbus is visible from the room and can react to oath-linked magic.
Varney is present as a large black guardian dog in the finalized room prose.
preparedInteractions: Oath-marked contact with the Star-Loom Carpet causes a visible ward reaction and starts the prepared countdown.
The signal horn can sound a tower-wide note and trigger ancient defensive behavior.
The black mirror is locally one-way until another linked portal or keystone is activated.

durableLocalFacts: The chamber served royal aerial couriers rather than ordinary military cavalry.
It preserves courier equipment, two griffon-scale flying saddles, a balcony ballista and a signal brazier.
A tapestry depicts Seralith and Aerlan side by side in the royal aerial tradition.
preparedInteractions: The prepared encounter is a staged orc/wyvern assault intended to create a localized breach in the blue barrier.
The room and adjoining kitchen contain multiple environmental tools for resisting the assault.

durableLocalFacts: The chamber is preserved as a lived-in private room shared by Seralith and Aerlan rather than a ceremonial royal suite.
Private portraits show Seralith informally with a bird and Aerlan with a younger Varney.
A concealed strongbox contains Moonlight in the Warrens: A Private Portfolio.
The makeup table contains functional self-applying enchanted cosmetics and the armoire contains preserved royal-era formal clothing.
explicitlyUnresolved: Some structured loot fields disagree with the finalized bedchamber prose; finalized room prose controls.
Bird-cage text is internally inconsistent about the number of remembered birds; do not normalize their identities until later evidence resolves it.

durableLocalFacts: Three non-sentient royal kitchen attendants are preserved at their work stations.
The constructs are intended for cooking, private-chamber maintenance and emergency response.
The kitchen contains an ever-hot stockpot and preserved food as part of the same long-running preservation magic.
preparedInteractions: The emergency horn protocol activates the kitchen attendants against invading orcs.
Kitchen furnishings are intentionally usable as environmental defenses during the balcony fight.
excludedMetagame: Geoff’s Fragmented Memory is a player/DM running aid, not in-world canon.

durableLocalFacts: A living tree grows through the chamber and physically embraces a black-mirror Royal Path portal.
The portal draws stability from the tree’s life force.
The tree bears old royal symbolism, including an eight-pointed-star form.
preparedInteractions: A glyph-key is presented as one possible activation method in the adventure.
explicitlyUnresolved: The tree’s degree of sentience is not established; do not choose among the adventure’s alternative options.
The exact key/activation implementation is not consistently established in this export.
Optional treasure is not canon until selected or encountered.

durableLocalFacts: The receiving portal is toppled and buried beneath old carpets in a dusty, forbidden storeroom.
The room contains old chests, wine barrels and inert suits of armor and opens toward the modern administrative complex above.
preparedInteractions: Disturbing the carpets creates a dust hazard.
Leaving obvious disturbance can trigger social/administrative consequences.
explicitlyUnresolved: Optional treasure and optional combat hooks are not canon until selected or encountered.

preparedEncounterFrames.name: Balcony Siege
preparedEncounterFrames.summary: Orc war mages on wyverns batter the local ward, followed by boarding orcs and a chained abused wyvern; the encounter is designed around delaying a localized breach and using the balcony/kitchen environment.
